description: UK company annual accounts: list the financial years of a UK company whose iXBRL accounts (Companies House Accounts Data Product, Open Government Licence v3.0) have been decoded, with balance-sheet dates, period, entity name, currency, accounting framework (micro-entity, FRS 102...) and accounts type. Electronically filed accounts only (~75% of UK filings) and depth accumulated since 2026-07: an empty answer does not mean no accounts exist. No default-risk score is computed for this country yet: the response carries score_defaillance (statut non_evaluable, closed-list reasons that GET /v1/lecture explains); never read it as a low score. A company with a current name under objection (GDPR art. 21) returns the same 404 as a number without decoded filing, not billed; a filing's entity name under objection is served null and counted in ecartes.opposition (item kept, block partial in provenance). Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

company_number.description: Companies House company number, 8 characters incl. leading zeros, e.g. 00095407 or SC123456

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: list_uk_company_accounts

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: UK accounts list (Companies House)
